reasoning.text: Reproducibility is capped by two spec gaps that made the impls diverge: a self-inconsistent N^-1 constant (8857 is wrong; correct is 12277) and the un-transcribed conflict-free bank/permutation functions, which the two impls disagree about (conflict-free vs provably conflicting at stage 6). Fidelity is moderate: the functional NTT uses the right named parameters (q=12289, N=1024, 14-bit, Barrett mu=21843/k=28, negacyclic, round-trip identity), but the paper's actual contributions — the conflict-free interleaved-BRAM/crossbar architecture, the no-bit-reversal addressing, and the quantified radix-4 op-count/hardware savings — are not reproduced, leaving only a generic correct NTT rather than the specific CFNTT datapath.
gaps: [param] Correct inverse-length constant N^-1 mod q (spec states 8857, which is wrong; correct value is 12277)
[param] Transform flavor explicitly stated (negacyclic vs cyclic) rather than 'unstated/implied'
[operation] The paper's actual conflict-free bank-index b(i) and offset o(i) functions plus per-stage read/write permutations σ_s (the headline Sec. III result)
[param] Twiddle-factor ROM contents, the chosen primitive root/generator binding, and ROM addressing/indexing scheme
[control] Bank addressing map from coefficient index to BRAM bank under interleaving
[timing] Reported pipeline cycle counts (mult/add-sub/Barrett/reg) — spec marks 3/1/4/1 as reproduction defaults pending the paper
[control] Radix-2/4 config-selector schedule / FSM state table and loop bounds governing radix switching
